We had taken Muramasa's Divine Art—
Survived it. Then Masamune's Divine Art had hit it back.

Immediate Retribution.
Take the attack inflicted on you, reproduce it, send it straight into the opponent. This was Soushuu Masamune's real specialty.

So that sword draw, lightning itself, should have struck Muramasa's own body...

en.html:
In that case, wouldn't we have gone down before we could hit it back?

...For one moment I thought that. Then corrected myself.

No. We were Masamune. We could not fall. Absolutely not.

Could not fall, therefore could always take the enemy's trump card. Simple. This Divine Art was the strongest move there was.

No problem.
Masamune did not fall. So no problem existed.

The ones who carried justice did not fall!

Whatever the wounds.
Even... even when the person I trusted betrayed me.

ja.html:
その場合、返す前にこっちが墜とされたんじゃない
のか。
　
　……一瞬だけそう思って、すぐに思い直す。

　そんなことはない。
　<ruby>正宗<rt>あたしたち</rt></ruby>は<ruby>絶対に倒れない<rt>・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>。

　倒れないから、つまり必ず敵の切り札を奪い取れる。
　この陰義は間違いなく最強の一手だ。

　問題は無い。
　正宗は倒れないのだから問題など無い。

　正義を背負う者は倒れないのだから！
　
　どれほどの傷を受けても、
　たとえ――信じた人に裏切られても。
